Sometimes, career exploration becomes meaningful when students get to see what a profession really looks like beyond the title.

During his job shadowing experience with Dr. Vinay at Vasavi Hospitals, Rishi Ganesh from Grade 9, Ekya School JP Nagar, discovered that being a doctor is not just about treating symptoms. It is about observing closely, making connections and thinking beyond what first appears obvious.

For Rishi, the experience offered a closer look at the kind of thinking, knowledge and responsibility the profession calls for, helping him understand a little more about the path he may want to take in the future.

There is so much happening behind the things we often take for granted.

How a cookie is produced. How silk begins. Why bees matter. What keeps soil alive.

A day spent looking closer gave students a new appreciation for the processes, organisms and systems working quietly all around us.

Our students teach us more than we sometimes realise.

Through their kindness, resilience, curiosity, wonder, and fearless self-expression, they remind us to notice the little things, ask more questions and not worry too much about getting everything “right.”

In every classroom, learning has a way of moving both ways.

Sometimes, a little pause can help us hear our thoughts more clearly.

During a Life Skills session at Ekya BTM, our Grade 10 and 12 students explored the word “EXAM” through a Free Association activity, noticing the thoughts, feelings and expectations that surfaced.

The session gently moved from reflection to quiet doodling, giving students space to slow down, reset and look at their thoughts with a little more awareness.

A simple reminder to carry forward:

Pause. Notice. Breathe. Choose.

#EkyaSchools #EkyaBTM #LifeSkills #StudentWellbeing #MindfulLearning

A thoughtful move, a steady game and a special moment on an international stage.

Congratulations to Sai Samarth of Grade 8, Ekya School ITPL, on securing 3rd place at an International FIDE-Rated Chess Tournament in Singapore.

It’s lovely to see his focus, patience and love for the game come together in such a memorable milestone.

What starts with a stall, a small purchase, or a shared moment can become part of something much bigger.

Our students come together to raise funds towards cataract surgeries for those in need. 

More than just a fundraising initiative, it is an opportunity for them to experience the value of giving, understand that every contribution matters and learn what it means to be responsible members of a community.

Because sometimes, the most meaningful lessons happen when we learn to look beyond ourselves.

#EkyaSchools #Learning #Fundraising #ServiceLearningProgram #Community

Some days bring learning a little closer to the world around us.

Our Grade 3 students from Ekya BTM spent the day at Bannerghatta National Park, observing animals, noticing their habitats and discovering small details about how they live.

There was curiosity in every sighting and plenty of excitement along the way. More than anything, the visit gave students a chance to pause, look closely, and feel a little more connected to the natural world.

A day filled with wonder, questions and memories to carry back to the classroom. 

#EkyaSchools #EkyaBTM #BannerghattaNationalPark  #LearningBeyondTheClassroom #WildlifeEducation

There’s something special about seeing a big idea come alive through a child’s eyes.

In this little exploration, our students discover electromagnetism and share their understanding in their own words, turning a complex concept into something simple, curious and their own.

Because learning feels a little more meaningful when you get to discover it together.

Learn from Little Humans.

Some days give children a little more room to simply wonder.

On Exploration Day, our students stepped beyond their usual routines to notice, question, create, and discover in ways that felt natural and joyful.

From new experiences to unexpected conversations, each moment became a small invitation to look at the world a little differently.

Because sometimes, the most meaningful learning begins with curiosity. ✨

To the teachers who notice the little things.
The extra minute, the quiet question, the small wins and the moments that never make it to a report.

Thank you for seeing every child, every day.
Happy Teacher's Day.

#EkyaSchool #TeachersDay #Fun #ThankYou

Some lessons stay in notebooks. Others stay with us for life. 

A teacher is the one who notices when you are unsure, encourages you before you are ready, listens when you need someone and believes in you until you begin to believe in yourself.

They make learning feel different. They help us step out of our comfort zones, find our confidence, discover what we are capable of and sometimes, simply make school feel like a place where we belong.

This Teachers’ Day, our students had a chance to choose the teacher who made that difference for them and tell them why.

Behind every rose was a memory.
Behind every “thank you” was a story.
And behind every story was a teacher who showed up, listened, encouraged, guided and cared.

Today is for all the teachers who do so much, often in ways that cannot be measured.

Thank you for the lessons, the patience, the belief, and for being there.

Happy Teachers’ Day to the teachers who leave a little bit of themselves in every student they teach. ❤️

 
#EkyaSchools #HappyTeachersDay #TeachersDay #LearningAtEkya #Gratitude

Not one of them named a job. Given the chance, our students reached for character first and with them choosing kindness, empathy and understanding, the future looks kind. 🧡
